_nguon: Stage 3.3 English overlay — 5-School Numerology Comparison (Modern Pythagorean, Balliett 1908, Westcott/Sepharial Classical, David Phillips Arrows/Pyramids, Cheiro Chaldean).

khung.phu_de: From the same birth date and name, each Western tradition highlights a distinct facet: Modern Pythagorean maps the Life Path, Balliett (1908) reads vibrational harmony, Westcott & Sepharial trace classical geometric-Kabbalistic roots, Phillips maps Birth Chart Arrows & Four Peaks, and Chaldean (Cheiro) weighs compound name numbers.
khung.cau_noi_dong_phuong: Numerology sketches core temperament and 9-year cycles from your solar birth date alone; to examine 12 specific life domains (career, property, partnerships) with birth hour and seasonal five-element structure, explore Zi Wei Dou Shu and BaZi alongside it.

westcott_1911.sach: W. Wynn Westcott · Numbers: Their Occult Power and Mystic Virtues (1911)
westcott_1911.nguyen_van_en: Pythagoras, one of the greatest philosophers of ancient Europe, was the son of Mnesarchus, an engraver. He was born about the year 580 B.C.
westcott_1911.phu_luc_en: Many nations of antiquity made use of the letters of their alphabets as substitutes for any independent signs to typify numerical conceptions.

sepharial_kabala.nguyen_van_en: Figures are the means employed by us to express definite quantities. They do not express anything of quality.
sepharial_kabala.phu_luc_en: One of the most interesting forms of the kabalism of numbers is that which relates names to incidents by means of the numerical value of letters.
